maintenance_led.reason: Sells cannabis consumables (Betty's Eddies edibles, flower, vapes) via own dispensaries and wholesale; used up, not maintenance of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying cannabis at dispensaries and from licensed retailers; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by cultivating, branding and selling products and opening dispensaries in MA, MD, IL, DE, MO; acquisitions occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers and retailers can easily switch to other cannabis brands or dispensaries; consumer products with low switching costs.
